title: Semantic Anchoring for Robotic Action Representations
abstract: arXiv:2607.13597v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models inherit rich semantic representations from pretrained Vision-Language Models, yet fine-tuning on limited robot demonstrations degrades this structure and undermines generalization. A fundamental question therefore arises: what constitutes a good action representation? Inspired by the mirror neuron theory's insight that observation and execution share an intention-level encoding, we examine whether a robot's action representations preserve the semantic structure captured by pretrained encoders. Systematic probing confirms that this structure erodes during finetuning, and that its quality synchronizes with both task success and out-of-distribution generalization. translated_title: 面向机器人动作表示的语义锚定方法
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型从预训练的视觉-语言模型中继承了丰富的语义表示，然而在有限的机器人演示数据上进行微调会破坏这种结构并削弱泛化能力。因此，一个根本性的问题随之而来：什么才是好的动作表示？受镜像神经元理论“观察与执行共享意图级编码”这一洞察的启发，我们研究了机器人的动作表示是否能够保留预训练编码器所捕获的语义结构。系统性探测实验证实，这种结构在微调过程中会逐渐退化，且其质量与任务成功率和分布外泛化能力同步变化。我们进一步提出了一种即插即用的方法，将动作表示锚定到语义流形上，同时将表示分解为共享语义通道和私有通道，这些模块在推理阶段全部被丢弃，从而保持部署模型不受影响……
tldr: 该论文发现VLA模型微调会破坏动作表示的语义结构并损害泛化能力，据此提出一种即插即用的语义锚定方法，通过将动作表示锚定到语义流形并分解为共享语义通道与私有通道，有效提升任务成功率与分布外泛化性能。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that finetuning degrades the semantic structure of VLA action representations, and proposes a plug-and-play semantic anchoring method that anchors action representations to a semantic manifold while decomposing them into shared semantic and private channels, thereby improving task success and out-of-distribution generalization.
